mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hami_vgpu_unit (id, hami_gpu_config_id, vgpu_index, vgpu_name, vgpu_mem_mb, vgpu_cores, node_selector_value, tolerations, available_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{hamiGpuConfigId}, #{vgpuIndex}, #{vgpuName}, #{vgpuMemMb}, #{vgpuCores}, #{nodeSelectorValue}, #{tolerations}, #{availableCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE hami_vgpu_unit SET vgpu_name = #{vgpuName}, vgpu_mem_mb = #{vgpuMemMb}, vgpu_cores = #{vgpuCores}, node_selector_value = #{nodeSelectorValue}, tolerations = #{tolerations}, available_count = #{availableCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE hami_vgpu_unit SET available_count = #{availableCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hami_vgpu_unit WHERE hami_gpu_config_id = #{hamiGpuConfigId} ORDER BY vgpu_index
